scope: Publish exact files, execute one metadata-only readiness worker, and only if fully qualified execute the one approved genuine saved-turret decoder sequence. No polling/retry, fallback, threshold change, computation probe or repair.

TunableOp environment-zero assignment and both actual flag checks, full input/weights, precision, source/native boundaries, memory plans, forward, serialization, release and containment are unchanged from the last reviewed worker.

Audit is installed before Torch import; unchanged ImportPolicy native_import frontend/dispatch denial and profile guard are active before GPU metadata queries. readiness_review.operations: Only genuine Torch TunableOp getters, runtime metadata, device count/properties/free VRAM, zero allocator queries, 12GiB per-process ceiling setting, synchronization and empty-cache cleanup. No model/weights, Tensor construction, convolution, kernel benchmark or learned stage.
readiness_review.qualification: Pinned runtime, RX 9070 XT/gfx1201/count1, free VRAM at least 13GiB before and after release, zero allocated/reserved before/release, zero allowed Tensor/rejection counters, no forbidden imports/errors, and recorded three flags false with three environment strings 0. The reused supervisor additionally requires exit0, healthy post-exit monitoring, unforced empty Job and successful named termination.
readiness_review.readiness_limit: A readiness PASS is an observed snapshot, not a guarantee of later free VRAM. The unchanged decoder still performs its own live 13GiB initial gate and every subsequent source-aware resource gate.

verification.full_candidate_read_only_preflight: Root record PASS with exact guest/helpers, metadata-only component, full checkpoint stream identity, sufficient host RAM/disk and no marker reserved.
